objective: Add a 'Reveal Intent' toggle to the Core Review Workspace that, when activated, displays a structured intent panel (business role, invariants, related rules, dependencies, evidence, confidence) sourced from the existing RevealIntent fixture via the established fixture→Zod→mapper→domain→UI pipeline.

requirements.description: FindingsPane must contain a prominently visible 'Reveal Intent' button within the F-001 finding detail area, visible without scrolling on a 1280 px wide viewport.

lib/review-workspace/loader.ts must be extended: import meridian-sample-intent.json, parse it through RevealIntentWireSchema.parse(), map via intentFromWireFormat(), and add the resulting RevealIntent to the MeridianReviewSession interface as an 'intent' field. No raw JSON field access beyond the parse step.
app/page.tsx must pass the intent field from getMeridianReviewSession() as a prop to FindingsPane.

FindingsPane must accept an optional 'intent?: RevealIntent' prop. When intent is absent, the component must render identically to its current Feature 3 behaviour — no regressions to TEST-201 through TEST-210.

Create app/components/IntentPanel.tsx as a Client Component. It must accept intent: RevealIntent and contract: BehavioralContract as props and render all of: (1) Business Role from intent.businessRole, (2) Intent Summary from intent.summary, (3) Behavioral Invariants as a bullet list from intent.invariants, (4) Related Behavioral Rules as pill/badge list with rule titles resolved from contract.rules using intent.relatedBehaviorRuleIds, (5) Dependencies list from intent.dependencies, (6) Confidence formatted via formatConfidence() from lib/review-workspace/confidence.ts, (7) Evidence items from intent.evidence using file, symbol, line range, kind, and excerpt. No domain text may be hardcoded in the component.

IntentPanel must visually distinguish inferred elements from observed facts. businessRole and summary must be labeled with a visible 'INFERRED' tag. invariants must be labeled 'OBSERVED'. Evidence items must display their 'kind' field value as a visible tag (source, test, dependency, change). Labels are visual only — no data-level changes.

The Reveal Intent action is a toggle. When the panel is closed, the button reads 'Reveal Intent'. When the panel is open, the button reads 'Hide Intent'. A second click collapses the panel. State is local React state inside FindingsPane.

The intent panel entry and exit must use CSS transitions only (no JS animation libraries). Entry transition must complete in 250 ms or less (ease-out). Exit transition must complete in 150 ms or less (ease-in). The transition must not cause layout shift in DiffPane or ReviewHeader.

Extract shortFilePath and formatLineRange helper functions from app/components/FindingsPane.tsx into lib/review-workspace/evidence-format.ts. Update FindingsPane.tsx to import them from evidence-format.ts. IntentPanel.tsx must also import them from evidence-format.ts. No logic may be duplicated.
Create app/__tests__/reveal-intent.test.tsx with exactly tests TEST-301 through TEST-308 as specified in the test requirements. All must pass.

non_requirements: No repository scanning, Java parsing, or git-diff generation.
No tab navigation (Review / Intent / Behavior Map / Tests tabs).
No Behavior Map or graph visualization.
No chat interface or conversation UI.
No multi-intent support (one RevealIntent per session).
No redesign of the DiffPane or ReviewHeader.
Do not modify demo/legacy-billing/src/**, pom.xml, proposed-change.patch, PROPOSED_CHANGE.md.
Do not modify lib/analysis/types.ts, parser.ts, review.ts, intent.ts, blast-radius.ts, metadata.ts.
Do not modify any lib/analysis/fixtures/*.json file.
Do not modify vitest.config.ts or package.json.

test_requirements.description: FindingsPane renders a button with text 'Reveal Intent' when the intent prop is provided.
Clicking the 'Reveal Intent' button causes the intent panel to appear in the DOM (IntentPanel content is visible).
IntentPanel renders intent.businessRole text from the Meridian fixture (contains text about computing late fee).
IntentPanel renders at least the first behavioral invariant from intent.invariants (the zero-balance guard text).
IntentPanel renders confidence as a percentage string — for intent.confidence 0.95, the rendered output contains '95%'.
IntentPanel renders an evidence item containing 'MoneyUtils.java' from intent.evidence.
Clicking 'Reveal Intent' a second time (when the panel is open) removes the intent panel content from the DOM.

security_requirements.description: intent data from meridian-sample-intent.json flows through RevealIntentWireSchema.parse() in loader.ts before reaching any UI component — no raw JSON field is accessed before validation.
IntentPanel receives and renders only a typed RevealIntent domain model — no raw JSON, no user-provided input, no external URLs.
No external URLs, network I/O, fetch calls, or API routes are introduced by this feature.

acceptance_criteria.description: 'npm test' exits 0: all prior tests TEST-001 through TEST-210 still pass, and new tests TEST-301 through TEST-308 pass.
'npm run lint' exits 0 with no new lint errors or warnings.
On a 1280 px viewport, the 'Reveal Intent' button is visible in the FindingsPane when F-001 is selected, without scrolling.
Clicking 'Reveal Intent' reveals a panel whose first visible text block contains the business role of LateFeeService.calculateLateFee from the fixture.
The panel shows at least one behavioral invariant as a bullet item.
Evidence items in the panel show MoneyUtils.java in the file path.
'BR-01' is visible in the related rules section of the intent panel.
Confidence is displayed as '95%' in the intent panel.
Button label is 'Reveal Intent' when closed and 'Hide Intent' when open.
Clicking 'Hide Intent' collapses the panel and restores the 'Reveal Intent' label.
Panel reveal uses a visible CSS transition; the panel does not appear/disappear instantaneously.
'git diff --name-only HEAD' shows no changes to demo/legacy-billing/**.
DiffPane and ReviewHeader are visually unchanged when the intent panel is open.
businessRole and summary sections in the intent panel each display a visible 'INFERRED' label; invariants section displays a visible 'OBSERVED' label.
